title: New Voxel Engine Reveal - Crystal Islands Experiment
summary: John Lin reveals a rewritten voxel engine demonstrated in a Crystal Islands scene, with much finer voxel detail, fast collision, fracture and path-traced global illumination.
why: HN cites it as a showcase of one of the best voxel engines, impressive for its detail and smoothness.

quote.text: Crystal Island looks amazingly detailed and smooth.
